Metadata.title: Rewrity
Metadata.description: Edit your text so it reads like a person wrote it. You review every change.

Home.title: Rewrity
Home.tagline: Paste a text. Rewrity marks stock phrases, filler and stiff constructions and suggests plainer wording. You decide on every change.
Home.headline: A second pair of eyes for your writing.
Home.demoOriginal: In today's fast-paced world, it is crucial to understand that effective communication plays a pivotal role in fostering meaningful connections.
Home.demoReason: Drops the stock opener and the inflated wording.
Home.sourcesTitle: Where the style references come from
Home.sourcesBody: Public-domain books and essays, historical newspapers, and recent news and magazine articles (up to 2022, before AI-written text became common online). Up to three excerpts are sent to Anthropic with your text to guide the edits; your browser only receives their source.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What this site stores and who sees your text.
Privacy.data: Your email address; for each rewrite, the original text, the suggested edits, the language and the date; and the number of attempts you make each day. To apply the limits, a record of each attempt is also kept for at least two days, then removed when a later attempt, from any account, passes the limits. Your writing sample is not stored. History entries stay until you delete them from the history page, which lists your 50 most recent. Your email and daily counts stay until your account is deleted, which only the site's owner can do for now. Your browser keeps your session cookies and your language and appearance choices.
Privacy.access: Other users cannot read any of this. The site's owner can: your text is stored as written, not encrypted against them. The site runs on Vercel and the data is stored with Supabase, whose sign-in service can also record your IP address and browser.
Privacy.ai: Your text is sent to Anthropic (Claude) to produce the suggestions, with your writing sample if you add one and up to three excerpts from the style corpus. Anthropic handles this data under its own terms. Do not submit text you are not allowed to share.
Privacy.limits: Suggestions are style edits. They do not change who wrote a text, and this tool does not detect AI-written text.
